text:
alina: Heads-up, SI partner asked for clearer guidance on how Redwood calculates marketplace usage when partners report minute-level events vs our hourly rollups. Theyneed to reconcile daily invoices with their internal telemetry.
sanjay: The core mismatch is windowing + clock skew. Partners often send events stamped in their local TZs and we normalize to UTC hours before aggregation. If an event lands exactly on the hour boundary we currently include it in the later hour.
ben: Could we publish a small reference implementation (node + py) that mirrors our windowing and dedupe logic? would lower integration friction.
marketplace-bot: Created task #MP-4210  publish-windowing-sdk (assignee: ben).
olga: suggestion: include sequence numbers and best-effort idempotency keys in the partner ingest contract. partner SDK could auto-retry with same idempotency key.
devrel: also make a lightweight test harness that partners can run to produce synthetic spikes and backfills. show expected ledger results.
alina: regarding reconciliation policy: propose 48h finalization window for hourly aggregates, with a 7-day backfill acceptance period. after 7 days ledger is final unless partner opens dispute.
sanjay: we need to surface late-arrivals metric in the webhook so partners know if a given hour is stable. e.g., {"hour":"2026-05-12T11:00Z","stable":false,"late_arrival_rate":0.12}.
ben: minor format nit: use ISO 8601 for hour keys and snake_case in payloads.
olga: security: ensure webhook payloads include HMAC-SHA256 signature using partner-specific secret.
alina: i'll draft a short PSR (partner service recommendation) doc and a checklist for SIs: timezone normalization, idempotency keys, signature header, test harness run, and dispute flow.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: weekly partner sync is Friday 10:00 PT.
alina: action items: ben -> publish reference SDK and test harness; sanjay -> add late-arrival metric and finalization flags to marketplace API; olga -> update security checklist; devrel -> create sample dataset and runbook examples.
olga: also file a tiny FAQ entry: "Why did my hour show 0 usage then later increase?" straightforward explanation + diagram.
alina: thanks team. i'll attach PSR to Friday deck and cc SIs.
